n.sample_role: Printed target-analysis participant counts: thief/person condition 74; jewel/object condition 76. Analytic total after exclusions cannot be securely established.
n.exclusions: Methods reports 150 recruited and 13 failed to complete, but Results prints N=74 and N=76. These statements are inconsistent; no subtraction or reconciliation performed.

The mean rating in the first case (thief/person contrast condition) was 6.21 (N=74 and SD=1.037).
The mean rating in the second case (jewel/object contrast condition) was 5.34 (N=76 and SD=1.837).

reported_success.quote:
Did you succeed in replicating the original result? If applicable, does the original team agree with you?
Yes on both counts.

notes: Original reference year in supplied citation is 2010; retrieved article is the 2012 Noûs version with matching title, authors, and DOI. Requested original test statistic is retained as printed. Replication effect size and p refer to the same main target comparison. Replication sample accounting is internally inconsistent: condition-specific Results Ns are retained as printed with low confidence; the recruited total is not substituted for an established post-exclusion analytic total. Supplied replication p. 2 locator is qualified because DOCX extraction does not independently preserve page boundaries. No further t statistic is printed for the replication.
